meta.description: Read, write, and convert phylogenetic tree files with Biopython Bio.Phylo, and choose an annotation-preserving parser (treeio, DendroPy) when metadata matters; covers BEAST/MrBayes annotation loss, Newick support-vs-label ambiguity, TRANSLATE and rooted/unrooted traps.
meta.executed: 7/7 inputs executed (Biopython 1.88, DendroPy 5.0.13, ete3 3.1.3, rdflib 7.6.0, treeio 1.30.0, ape 5.8.1, IQ-TREE 2.4.0, MrBayes 3.2.7a)
meta.execution_note: All trees are SYNTHETIC: IQ-TREE treefile from an AliSim alignment of a known 10-taxon tree (RF to truth 0); MrBayes .con.tre/.t from a 20k-generation run on that alignment; BEAST MCC Nexus hand-written to TreeAnnotator layout with known values; NHX (ete3), phyloXML (hand-written), NeXML (DendroPy), odd-name Newick, two TRANSLATE-permuted .t files and a posterior-labelled Newick from data/make_data.py. Every script and all three shipped examples ran (exit codes recorded). Two auditor-side retries are logged: an API slip in Input 4 (TreeList.encode_bipartitions) and Windows cp1252 encoding in Input 3. rdflib was installed mid-audit to test the cdao claim; the pre-install KeyError is kept in runs/in5/format_matrix.log.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated numbers; every posterior, HPD and support value reported came from parsing the synthetic files and was checked against the known values in mcc6_truth.tsv or the simulated tree.

practice_boundaries.detail: Tree file I/O for research; nothing diagnoses, prescribes or triages an individual.

methodological_ground.detail: No methodological fallacy in any output: annotations extracted before down-conversion, burn-in removed per run before pooling, TRANSLATE-aware merging, support provenance kept explicit, no relabelling of posteriors as bootstraps.

code_usability.detail: All delivered Python and R code ran to exit 0. The Skill's DendroPy snippet and Bio.Phylo calls run as written; failures found (Bio.Phylo on MrBayes .con.tre, cdao without rdflib, cp1252 file I/O on Windows) are documented-behaviour gaps recorded as P1/P2, not unrunnable code.

functional_suitability.note: Right approach and good coverage (annotations, dual support, posterior sets, names, TRANSLATE). Correctness 2/4: 'Phylo.convert ... Newick cannot hold [&...]; annotations dropped' is false on Biopython 1.88 (comments are written escaped as [\[&...\]], which DendroPy and treeio then fail to parse); 'cdao' is listed as supported but only registers when rdflib is installed; nothing says Bio.Phylo crashes on MrBayes .con.tre or names NeXML tips by otu id.

reliability.note: Common Errors table with cause and fix, 'keep the original .tree as source of truth', introspect-and-adapt rule. Missing failure modes seen in execution: file encoding, Bio.Phylo AssertionError on .con.tre, ape and ete3 mishandling quoted labels.

performance_context.note: 169-line SKILL.md, dense tables, no redundant workflow steps; everything loads at once but it is compact.

agent_usability.note: Immediately learnable decision rule and strong pitfall list. Internal inconsistency: 'Newick cannot hold [&...]' contradicts 'metadata rides inside a Nexus (or Newick) [&...] comment'. No output format for the side table or loss report; values come back from DendroPy as strings without a warning to cast.

human_usability.note: Usage guide has natural prompts; the description is long and jargon-dense; the sanitize-and-round-trip advice copes with off-spec names.

security.note: Local files only, no credentials, no exec of user strings; name sanitisation advised, but no guidance on file encoding.

maintainability.note: Clear sections and routing. Shipped examples are toy strings: convert_formats.py claims to demonstrate lossy conversion but converts an annotation-free tree phyloXML->Nexus and only prints the claim; no example covers BEAST/MrBayes/IQ-TREE files.

agent_specific.note: Precise trigger, explicit routing to tree-manipulation, tree-visualization, bayesian-inference, divergence-dating and read-sequences (all exist). I/O is idempotent. Escape hatches cover scope but not 'ask what program wrote the file' when support provenance is unknown.

recommendations.title: Fix the Phylo.convert-to-Newick annotation claim
recommendations.problem: SKILL.md says Phylo.convert nexus->newick drops [&...] annotations; Biopython 1.88 writes them as escaped [\[&...\]] comments that DendroPy (posterior None) and treeio read.beast.newick (column '\[&posterior') cannot parse.
recommendations.root_cause: The claim was not checked against NewickIO._format_comment, which escapes brackets inside the comment.
recommendations.fix: State that Bio.Phylo carries comments into Newick in an escaped, non-standard form that other readers mis-parse, so the annotations are effectively corrupted; keep the rule 'extract first, then write with DendroPy suppress_annotations=True, suppress_rooting=True'.

recommendations.title: Warn where Bio.Phylo fails on Nexus/NeXML inputs
recommendations.problem: Phylo.read on a MrBayes .con.tre raises AssertionError 'Two string taxonomies?', and Phylo.read on DendroPy NeXML names tips by otu id (d10, d8...). Neither is mentioned.
recommendations.root_cause: The tool taxonomy lists Bio.Phylo for general Nexus/NeXML work without testing annotated MrBayes or foreign NeXML files.
recommendations.fix: Add Common Errors rows: MrBayes .con.tre -> use DendroPy or treeio read.mrbayes; NeXML from other tools -> check tip names, prefer DendroPy.

recommendations.title: Add encoding and quoted-label guidance
recommendations.problem: Path-based Bio.Phylo/DendroPy I/O on Windows decoded and wrote cp1252, garbling a non-ASCII tip; ape read 'O''Brien isolate 7' as NA; ete3 raised on quoted names. The assertion pass rate (26/34) missed the Limited Release floor partly on these.
recommendations.root_cause: The name-trap section covers sanitisation but not file encoding or per-tool quoted-label support.
recommendations.fix: Tell the agent to pass explicit UTF-8 handles (open(p, encoding='utf-8')) for read and write, and to sanitise before ape or ete3 ever see quoted labels.

recommendations.title: Document rdflib for cdao and string-typed DendroPy values
recommendations.problem: 'cdao' raises KeyError unless rdflib is installed and then drops confidences; DendroPy returns posterior and HPD as strings.
recommendations.root_cause: Format list and snippet omit optional dependencies and value types.
recommendations.fix: Note 'cdao requires pip install rdflib'; cast with float() in the DendroPy snippet.

recommendations.title: Make the shipped examples demonstrate the Skill's claims
recommendations.problem: convert_formats.py converts an annotation-free tree phyloXML->Nexus and prints a claim about loss without showing any; no example covers BEAST, MrBayes or IQ-TREE files or splitting dual support in Python.
recommendations.root_cause: Examples predate the annotation-focused rewrite of SKILL.md.
recommendations.fix: Ship a small annotated MCC string plus a DendroPy extraction and an IQ-TREE dual-label split, each printing before/after annotation counts.
